title: Lighter testnet — Long press opens a working order form seeded at the venue minimum
description: Success-path validation of the one-click trade flow on Lighter testnet (originally a defect repro: the same press used to fail with 'Could not open position' because the deposit scaffold targeted Lighter's informational devnet chain eip155:123456). After the route-contract fix (getDepositRoutes isTestnet override), the DepositService guard, and the dynamic per-market minimum (Terminal API gated to HyperLiquid-backed providers; LighterProvider computes a grid-aware binding minimum), pressing Long on ETH must land on PerpsOrderView with the amount seeded at the venue minimum (~$10.16 at ETH ~$1900, margin ≈ amount/3x) and an enabled place-order button.

restart-app.intent: Restart so provider init and log watches are deterministic.

unlock-wallet.intent: Fixture wallet ready (dev1 owns Lighter venue account 899).

open-provider-picker.intent: Open the venue picker so the run selects Lighter testnet regardless of persisted venue.

settle-switch.intent: Lighter venue initializes; account resolves by address (no configured-index pin).

watch-registered.intent: Venue session is live before driving the trade surface.

open-eth-market.intent: Open ETH details — the surface where the original defect was observed.

settle-eth.intent: Details render with live prices; Long/Short row appears.

pre-screenshot.intent: ETH details with the Long button, Lighter testnet active.

press-long.intent: The exact user action that used to fail; must now open the order form.

settle-press.intent: Let the one-click-trade path route into PerpsOrderView and seed the form.

assert-order-form.intent: SUCCESS SIGNATURE: the order form rendered with its place-order button — the press no longer dead-ends in the deposit scaffold.

assert-no-failure-toast.intent: The original defect toast must NOT appear.

assert-venue-min-size.intent: Amount seeded at the venue minimum, not the flat $10 default: 0.0053 ETH is Lighter's grid-ceiled minimum base size (~$10.16 at ETH ~$1900); the old default would read 0.0052 ETH. Price-sensitive — if ETH moves far from ~$1900, re-derive the expected size (max(min_base, min_quote/price) ceiled to 4 decimals).

post-screenshot.intent: Order form seeded above the venue floor with an enabled Long ETH button (margin ≈ amount/3x confirms the seeded amount).
